gene_list.description: ACMG Secondary Findings v3.2 actionable genes (2023). ~73 genes covering hereditary cancer, cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia, aortic disease, familial hypercholesterolaemia, and other actionable Mendelian conditions.

exon_coordinates.transcript_selection: MANE Select where present; Ensembl_canonical otherwise; longest transcript as final fallback
exon_coordinates.transcript_selection_outcome: 160/160 genes covered by MANE Select transcripts (no fallback to Ensembl_canonical or longest required for the current panel).
exon_coordinates.alias_map_note: Panel HGNC symbol → GENCODE v44 symbol where HGNC has since renamed the gene. BED labels preserve the panel symbol (so `GBA_exon_N` rows refer to GENCODE's GBA1 coordinates).

curation_notes: Union of ACMG SF v3.2, GenomeClaw five disease-area sysprompt panels, and PharmCAT-flagged pharmacogenomic genes. Deduplicated: APOE appears in both cardiovascular and neurodegeneration panels and is counted once. PTEN, MUTYH, PCSK9 appear in both ACMG and disease-area panels; counted once. Exon coordinates are real GENCODE v44 MANE Select; safe for live mosdepth coverage analysis.
